user.title: Heizwerk
user.description: House-wide sensors. Add rooms afterwards with 'Add room'.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Outdoor sensor for the summer lock and the airing time. Recommended; without it there is no summer lock.
data_description.season_entity: Heating is locked while this entity is off. Optional; without it heating is always allowed.

summer_lock.name: Summer lock
summer_lock.description: Stops heating in warm weather, independent of the heating period.

data_description.summer_lock_temperature: Locks heating when it is at least this warm outside. Default 16 °C; 0 disables the summer lock.
data_description.summer_lock_minutes: The outdoor temperature must stay above the limit this long. Default 10 min.

climate.name: Room climate
climate.description: Outdoor values for dew point and airing recommendation.

data_description.outdoor_humidity: Used for the outdoor dew point: airing is only recommended when the outside air is drier. Optional.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Outdoor sensor for the summer lock and the airing time. Recommended; without it there is no summer lock.
data_description.season_entity: Heating is locked while this entity is off. Optional; without it heating is always allowed.

summer_lock.description: Stops heating in warm weather, independent of the heating period.

data_description.summer_lock_temperature: Locks heating when it is at least this warm outside. Default 16 °C; 0 disables the summer lock.
data_description.summer_lock_minutes: The outdoor temperature must stay above the limit this long. Default 10 min.

climate.name: Room climate
climate.description: Outdoor values for dew point and airing recommendation.

data_description.outdoor_humidity: Used for the outdoor dew point: airing is only recommended when the outside air is drier. Optional.

data_description.name: Shown on the card; the entity becomes climate.heizwerk_ plus the room name (e.g. climate.heizwerk_bad).
data_description.trvs: All thermostats of the room; they all get the same set-point.
data_description.temperature_sensor: External room sensor, strongly recommended. Without it the thermostats' own readings are averaged.
data_description.observe_only: Computes and shows the planned commands but sends nothing. Default on; keep it on while the old heating control still runs in parallel.

schedule.name: Schedule & resume
schedule.description: Your scheduler (Zeitwerk, Scheduler, automation) sets the room via climate.set_temperature. Here: plan display and what 'Resume' does. Resume: empty = zeitwerk.resume for the detected plan, without a plan resume is hidden; for Scheduler e.g. scheduler.run_action with the schedule switch.

data_description.zeitwerk_plan: Optional, detected automatically: the Zeitwerk plan whose profile actions set this room. Only used for display (profile, day band, until).
data_description.resume_action: What happens on 'Resume' and when 1 h / 3 h run out. Empty with a detected Zeitwerk plan: zeitwerk.resume for that plan. Empty without plan: Resume is hidden. For Scheduler e.g. scheduler.run_action with the schedule switch.

room_climate.name: Room climate
room_climate.description: Humidity, wall temperature and airing recommendation.

data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity for dew point and airing recommendation. Optional.
data_description.wall_temperature_sensor: Coldest wall surface; gives the wall humidity (mold risk). Optional.
data_description.humidity_threshold: Airing is recommended above this room humidity. Default 60 %; bathrooms 65–70 %.

windows_locks.name: Windows & locks
windows_locks.description: Window contacts, additional locks and what happens while heating is locked.

data_description.windows: Heating is locked while a window is open. Optional.
data_description.window_open_delay: Delay before an open window locks heating. Default 30 s.
data_description.window_close_delay: Delay before heating resumes after closing. Default 10 s.
data_description.lock_entities: Heating is locked while one of these is on, e.g. a maintenance switch. Not for holidays or absence, that is Zeitwerk's job.
data_description.lock_mode: Off relies on the thermostat's built-in frost protection (fine for Sonoff TRVZB). Default off.
data_description.frost_temperature: Set-point while locked in frost mode. Default 7 °C.

regulation.name: Regulation (advanced)
regulation.description: How the set-point reaches the thermostats. Use either the external temperature input or offset, never both.

data_description.correction: Added to the set-point sent to the thermostats, e.g. -0.5 K. Default 0; use 0 with an external temperature input.
data_description.regulation: Set-point sends target plus correction (recommended). Offset also adds thermostat reading minus room sensor; only for thermostats without external input.
data_description.external_temperature_entities: e.g. number.…_external_temperature_input. For Sonoff TRVZB preferred: set temperature_sensor_select to external in Z2M, regulation set-point, correction 0.

limits.name: Set-points & limits
limits.description: Initial set-point and allowed set-point range.

data_description.default_target: Used until the first set-point arrives from your schedule or the card. Default 20 °C.

set_manual.name: Set manual target
set_manual.description: Overrides the planned set-point of a room until the next Zeitwerk change or for a duration.

sync.name: Sync thermostats
sync.description: Re-evaluates the room and sends pending commands now (nothing in observe-only mode).

target_entity_removed.title: Heizwerk: Zeitwerk target of room {room} is no longer used
target_entity_removed.description:
Since Heizwerk 0.4 the schedule writes to the room entity directly. The configured Zeitwerk target `{entity}` is ignored.

To switch:
1. Change the profile actions of the room's Zeitwerk plan to `climate.set_temperature` targeting `{climate}`.
2. Open the room in the Heizwerk integration and save it once – then this notice disappears.
